purpose: Current public search control geometry and CSS hover observation for A00 development; not a formal pixel, WCAG or E04 gate
theme: light via prefers-color-scheme emulation in fresh anonymous context
context: New isolated browser context using existing 127.0.0.1:9222; destroyed after capture
privacy: Search captures serialize only .search-form, .search-btn, its svg and drawing-element tag/class/allowlisted SVG size and paint attributes, element rectangles and computed CSS; no search SVG path data copied. The separately scoped metaIcons appendix records eye/chat SVG boxes, circle dimensions and paint; raw path strings are omitted. No input value, visible text, href, user identifier, avatar source, post content, count, Cookie or session read or saved. Scripts, images and media blocked.

findings.button: 32×26 CSS px at both widths; display:flex, flex:0 0 auto, align-items:center, padding:6px 9px.
findings.svg: 14×14 CSS px. Root SVG computed stroke is none and stroke-width is 1px; the circle and path each explicitly use currentColor and stroke-width 1.4px.
findings.hover: Actual mouse hover changes button and inherited SVG color from rgb(85,90,106) to rgb(51,64,143), restored on pointer leave; no CSS forcing.

metaIcons.method: The search context had closed; a second fresh anonymous context was created and destroyed for targeted eye/chat SVG attributes and computed boxes only. Page JavaScript disabled; script/image/media loads blocked. Geometry identifies the controls without reading surrounding text or counts.
metaIcons.privacy: Only the eye/chat SVG attributes, drawing-element paint and closest .meta-icon box were serialized; no user text, numeric statistics, links, Cookie or session data read or saved.
metaIcons.finding: At both 1440px and 390px, eye/chat SVG.meta-icon is 13×13 CSS px, display:block, flex:0 0 auto, vertical-align:-2px, color rgb(107,111,126). ViewBox is 0 0 24 24; drawing-element stroke-width is 2 user units, with currentColor. The initially proposed 12×12 outer box is not supported by this current observation.
